correctness.rationale: Exact Fermat geometric-median rule yields 1/3 rim measure through a Dirichlet gap calculation. Globally unique two-orientation polar rays parametrize every interior Fermat triple. The direct angular Jacobian equals (sqrt(3)/2)*(sum ray lengths)/(product h), giving the complete planar density. Four noncoincident square-root singularities each contribute a logarithm, with bounded difference; central and rim-shell coefficients follow by direct integration. Checker independently tests Jacobian and Monte Carlo CDF. No reliance on finite simulation for proof.

value.rationale: The exact location distribution of a canonical Euclidean Fermat/Steiner facility-location center is a natural and nontrivial stochastic-geometric invariant. Its exact mixed two-dimensional law has an unanticipated 1/3 singular boundary component plus a positive interior density with a sharp logarithmic rim singularity. A global three-dimensional Jacobian and four-singularity analysis are required; the result is not a routine re-expression of known Steiner length statistics.
